 CORAM: HONOURABLE MR. JUSTICE RAJIV ROY  ORAL ORDER 2 06-05-2025 Heard the parties.

2. The present petition has been preferred for the grant of following relief(s):
"(i) For issuance of a writ in the nature of Mandamus commanding and directing the Respondent authorities not to acquire the lands of the petitioner beyond the proposed scheme for acquisition of land for the purpose Gandak Project Yojna as the said lands which has been acquired 1 Acre 87  decimals in his absence and without permission of the petitioner on 12.10.1974 by notification no. 345 dated 12.07.1974 without taking any step and without following the procedure of land acquisition Act.

(ii) For issuance of a writ in the nature of Patna High Court CWJC No.16910 of 2017(2) dt.06-05-2025 prohibition restraining the respondent authorities from interfering with the right, title and possession of the petitioner over the land in question.

(iii) For to direct the concerned Respondent authorities to compensate the loss accrued to the petitioner due to illegal and high handed acts of authorities and also to pay heavy damage and cost for under harassment caused to the petitioner.

sentences.text: (iv) For to direct the respondent authorities to take serious action against its officers and employees who were responsible for such heinous act causing grievous loss to the petitioner.

(vi) For to restrain the concerned Respondent authorities from using the land in question of the petitioner without adopting any procedure of land acquisition and payment of entire compensation etc in accordance with law.

(vii) For that the said land as the petitioner has been acquired for the purpose Gandak project Yojna without any due procedure as no any Patna High Court CWJC No.16910 of 2017(2) dt.06-05-2025 notice has been issued to the petitioner and there is now no any requirement for the said Gandak Project Yojna.
(viii) For issuing any other writ order or directions and reliefs which the petitioner is entitled."
3. Let the State file counter affidavit in the matter.

4. It is made clear that the matter is of the year 2017, if the State fails to file counter affidavit within next eight weeks, a cost of Rs.2,000/- is to be deposited with the Patna High Court Legal Services Committee.
5.
